user.title: Laundry Discord Bot
user.description: Connect a self-hosted Discord bot that watches your washer and posts a single, self-updating message per load. See the README for how to create the bot token and find the channel ID.

data.confirm_delay: Confirm delay — how long a state must hold before acting (seconds)
data.energy_idle: Energy-idle backstop — flat kWh for this long = done, used ONLY when the washer's own completion estimate is unavailable (an offline load) (minutes)
data.energy_load_jump: Offline-load detection — energy jump this big (with no wash phase) = a load ran while offline (kWh)
data.ping_claimant_on_complete: @mention whoever claimed the load when it's done
data.availability_grace: Hold last ETA through a connection blip (minutes)
data.handoff_fallback: Handoff backstop — ping whoever's next this long after a load finishes when the claimant never tapped "Emptied it" (minutes, 0 disables)
data.queue_expiry: "I'm next" expiry — drop somebody from the line this long after they tapped it, so a stale line never strands a handoff (hours)
data.show_assistant: Show the 🤖 assistant button on the card — opens a private panel with the first-time explainer and each person's ping settings (DM / channel / off). Off hides the button; anything already chosen in it keeps working.
data.learn_habits: Learn the days each person washes — note the day and time of each 🧺 Claim, and mark the slots somebody usually uses with ? on their own week grid. Off by default. Nothing is ever shown to the channel and nobody sees anyone else's guesses; each person can also switch themselves off with 👁 Monitoring in the 🤖 panel.
data.remind_dms: Send reminder DMs — the only setting that lets the bot decide, on its own, to message somebody who didn't tap anything first (the other one that can DM people is Swap requests below, and there a housemate is doing the asking). Off by default. It needs day-learning on as well, and it only ever DMs a person who chose 📬 DM in the 🤖 panel, left 🔮 guessing on, and has a confident prediction: max 1 DM per person per day, 2 per week, dropped rather than queued when over. The Sunday check-in carries a 🔕 Stop asking button; the day-of nudge carries 🚫 Skip this week, and 🤖 → 🔮 Stop guessing turns the lot off for good.
data.plan_dm_weekday: Weekly plan DM — which day to ask people whether next week's guess looks right (nothing is sent to anyone the model isn't confident about)
data.plan_dm_time: Weekly plan DM — what time of day to send it
data.trades: Swap requests — let people ask each other for a slot. Tap a slot on 📅 your week that somebody else is down for and 🔁 asks them, anonymously, whether they'd trade it for one of yours. Off by default. The DM never says who is asking and never says whose slot it is; only ✅ accepting reveals the two names, and only to each other. Every guardrail is on: one ask per slot per person per week, a slot somebody was refused is shut to everyone until next week, 🚫 Don't ask me again is permanent for that pair, one ask in flight per person in each direction, you must hold a slot of your own to offer, unanswered asks lapse after 48h, and the recipient must have chosen 📬 DM in the 🤖 panel — all inside their 1-DM-a-day budget.
data.nudge_lead: Slot heads-up lead — how long before the START of a slot somebody booked to ask whether they still want it. The message carries “Free it up”, so a slot that is about to lapse unused goes back to the house instead of blocking it. Only one message is ever sent per person per day, whichever trigger gets there first (minutes)

test_post.name: Test post
test_post.description: Post a sample embed with a working Claim button to test the Discord path without a real wash.

reset_session.name: Reset session
reset_session.description: Force-close the load the bot thinks is running and go back to idle. Announces nothing and pings nobody.

diagnostics.name: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Check the bot's health and return the findings as response data. Changes nothing; safe to run mid-wash.
